app_store.name: Mate Wareware: Golden Moments
app_store.subtitle: Mahi whakaahua mō te Alzheimer
app_store.promotional_text: He mahi ngāwari hei rata ngātahi: he taera pikitia nunui, ō whakaahua whānau, kāore he pae wā, he tātai rānei. He whakamahara kōwhiringa. Kāore he kaute.
app_store.description:
Kimihia tētahi mahi ngāwari hei rata ngātahi. Ka tuku a Golden Moments i te whakarite pikitia ngāwari me te tiro whakaahua ngātahi mō ngā whānau me ngā kaiāwhina, tae atu ki te hunga e noho tahi ana me tētahi tangata e ora ana me te mate wareware, te mate Alzheimer rānei.

TĪMATA MĀ TE ITI
Tīmata mā ngā taera nunui e whā me ngā pikitia tīmatanga e mōhio ana. Kia kitea ngā pikitia, huna rānei ina pai ana. Kāore he pae wā, he tātai, he whiu i te aratau ngāwari. Kōwhiria te 4, te 6, te 8, te 12 rānei o ngā taera, i te wā e wātea ana.

MĀ TŌ WHĀNAU TONU
Kōwhiria ngā whakaahua whānau mā te kaitīpako whakaahua o tō pūrere. Ka tiakina e Golden Moments ngā kape iti ake mō ngā mahi o te rohe; kāore ia e rapu i tō whare pukapuka whakaahua, e panoni rānei i ō whakaahua taketake. Pupurihia tae atu ki te 24 whakaahua i tētahi kohinga kotahi.

TIRO NGĀTAHI NOA
Tirohia tētahi pikitia i ia wā. Ka tono ngā tohu kōrero kōwhiringa kia kōrero tahi, me te kore e tono i tētahi kia maumahara ki ngā ingoa, kia hoatu rānei i tētahi whakautu tika. Ka rawaka te tiro noa.

ME TE KORE IPURANGI KI TE WĀHI E TIKA ANA
Kei te wātea tonu ngā pikitia tīmatanga. Ka mahi me te kore ipurangi ngā kape whakaahua kua kawea mai, i muri i te kawe mai. Mēnā ka kōwhiria he mea taketake e tiakina ana ki iCloud anake, tērā pea me hono ki te ipurangi. Kei roto i te taupānga ngā pūranga pikitia e waru katoa, me te kore he tikiake whakaahua motuhake.

KĀORE HE KAUTE, KĀORE HE TŪMAU TUKUTAHI WHAKAAHUA
Ka noho ngā kape whakaahua whānau ki te taupānga i tēnei pūrere. Ka taea e koe te tango i ngā kape me te kore e mukua ngā mea taketake. Tērā pea ka uru ngā raraunga taupānga ki ngā kape tautoko o te pūrere. Kāore tēnei putanga e tukutahi whakaahua i waenga i ngā whanaunga.

He mahi whakangahau me te kōrero tahi a Golden Moments. Kāore ia e tātari, e rongoā, e ārai, e ine rānei i te mate wareware, i te mate Alzheimer rānei. Ehara ngā mahi i te mea tika mō te katoa; whaia ngā mea e rata ana te tangata me tōna noho humarie, ā, whakamutua, whakarerekētia rānei te mahi ina tika.
app_store.release_notes: Ngā mata mārama ake mō te tākaro ngātahi. Ka wehe te kēmu pikitia tuatahi i ia takirua. Ka pai ake ngā whārangi ki te tuhinga nui, ā, ka whai te tuhinga i te rahi o tō waea, tae atu ki te rua ngā wā te rahi noa. Kāore a Tirohia ngātahi e tātai i ngā pikitia. I Tēnei rā, kua tohua ngā nama āwhina mō te U.S., me tētahi tuhipoka mō te nama o te rohe ki wāhi kē. He mea whakamāori mīhini, kāore anō kia arotakengia. Mēnā he hē, whakamōhiotia mai i Āwhina me te tūmataiti.
